question: Identify the youngest driver (by latest date of birth) who earned points in the most recent British Grand Prix held at Brands Hatch. Return their forename, surname, the race date, and the number of points they earned.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, r.XCL_070, res.XCL_082
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits AS c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Brands Hatch'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND res.XCL_082 > 0
ORDER BY r.XCL_066 DESC, d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1

roles.description: Lap time recorded in the first qualifying session (Q1). This is the most frequently populated time column, serving as the baseline for all qualifying entries.

SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, r.XCL_070, res.XCL_082
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.XCL_074 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits AS c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
JOIN drivers AS d ON res.XCL_075 = d.XCL_034
WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Brands Hatch'
  AND r.XCL_069 = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND res.XCL_082 > 0
ORDER BY r.XCL_066 DESC, d.XCL_040 DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM drivers AS T1
JOIN results AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_075"
JOIN races AS T3 ON T2."XCL_074" = T3."XCL_065"
JOIN circuits AS T4 ON T3."XCL_068" = T4."XCL_001"
